**The Castle in Kufstein**

<iframe src="https://www.google.com/maps/embed?pb=!1m18!1m12!1m3!1d2737.532439334233!2d11.96361071577131!3d47.50344997975724!2m3!1f0!2f0!3f0!3m2!1i1024!2i768!4f13.1!3m3!1m2!1s0x477b833989776d41%3A0x5852927594685740!2sKufstein%20Castle!5e0!3m2!1sen!2sus!4v1620000000000!5m2!1sen!2sus" width="600" height="450" style="border:0;" allowfullscreen="" loading="lazy"></iframe>

**Discover the impressive Kufstein Fortress**, one of the most important and best-preserved medieval castles in Europe. Perched on a rocky outcrop above the Inn River, this fortress offers breathtaking views of the surrounding **Tirol** landscape.

**History & Architecture**
Built in the 13th century, the fortress has been expanded and modified over the centuries. The **Kaiserjagdhaus** (Emperor’s Hunting Lodge), a Renaissance-style building, is a highlight. The fortress also houses a museum showcasing its rich history, including the famous **Kufstein Riddle** and the **Golden Bull of Emperor Maximilian I**.

**Experiences**
- **Guided tours**: Explore the fortress with expert guides who share fascinating stories about its past.
- **Panoramic views**: Enjoy stunning vistas from the fortress walls, especially at sunset.
- **Events**: The fortress hosts concerts, medieval festivals, and other cultural events throughout the year.
- **Restaurants & Cafés**: Relax in the **Burgcafé** or enjoy traditional **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** with a view.

**Location & Accessibility**
The fortress is located in the heart of **Kufstein**, just a short walk from the city center. It’s easily accessible by car, bus, or train, with parking available nearby. The **Inn River Promenade** offers a scenic route for those arriving on foot.

**Visit the Castle in Kufstein** and step back in time to experience one of **Tirol’s** most iconic landmarks!
